title: S3.7c ACIS finite straight-edge proximity predicate

scope.profile: Decoded straight ACIS edge; parser-fed SAB 21800 rooted edge also exercised
scope.public_api: drw_pointWithinToleranceOfAcisStraightEdge tests Euclidean distance to the finite edge interval and returns the raw curve parameter on acceptance.
scope.parameter_policy: The nearest parameter is clamped to the closed interval derived from both topological endpoint projections.
scope.endpoint_policy: Both endpoints must be present, finite, and within the explicit endpointCurveTolerance of the decoded supporting curve.
scope.tolerance_policy: Endpoint-consistency and query-to-edge tolerances must be finite and nonnegative; neither is an ACIS/modeler default.
scope.refusal_policy: Invalid tolerance, missing/off-curve endpoints, unsupported curve, invalid query, unrepresentable projection/residual, or out-of-tolerance query returns false without changing parameter.
non_claims: B-rep validity or native/independent semantic qualification
